provisions.heading: Stock indices for the purposes of Article 344 of Regulation (EU) No 575/2013
provisions.text_md: The list of stock indices, for which the treatments set out in the second sentence of Article 344(4) of Regulation (EU) No 575/2013 is available, are provided in the Annex.

provisions.heading: Entry into Force
provisions.text_md: This Regulation shall enter into force on the twentieth day following that of its publication in the *Official Journal of the European Union*.
